{"code": "df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length per species
grouped = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().reset_index()

# Print the full group means to capture the values
print(grouped)

# Find and print the species with the highest mean
highest_species = grouped.loc[grouped['flipper_length_mm'].idxmax()]['species']
print(f'Highest mean flipper length species: {highest_species}')"}
